fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: A service wants to impose a computational cost on high-volume requests.

fields.label: Steps
value: Select a difficulty policy appropriate to the service and request context.
Have the client search for a stamp whose SHA-1 digest satisfies the stated leading-zero requirement, if reproducing the historical example.
Verify the supplied stamp and its bound fields.
Reject invalid or policy-expired stamps and apply ordinary abuse controls as well.

fields.value: The service can impose asymmetric computational cost, while recognizing that PoW is only one abuse-control mechanism.
